core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers espresso machines with sleek, modern designs, especially in stainless steel finishes. He seeks a café-like experience without being overly complex—ideal for non-professional users who value both performance and aesthetics.
core_memory.user_inquiry_pricing: Michael is a first-time buyer looking for pricing details on espresso machines, specifically interested in any new customer discounts, promotional offers, or bundle deals. He saw a 'New Customer Discount' on the homepage but didn't click it in time.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry: Michael in Seattle is concerned about shipping times and origin. He wants to know if products are shipped from a local warehouse, especially given his upcoming family gathering later this month. He values reliability and timely delivery, especially in rainy weather.
core_memory.user_temperature_inquiry: Michael is concerned about coffee temperature and wants to know if espresso machines offer adjustable temperature settings or reliably hot coffee. He previously had issues with drip makers that were too cool, leading him to microwave his coffee.
